scope: Two neighboring opaque 32-cell cooked tiles, guarded fixed-tick compaction, live collision, save continuation and bounded Vulkan observation.
limits: The contract covers a fixed two-tile region and explicitly scripted stamps.
GPU observations come from small deterministic fixtures at the recorded extents.

authoring_guard_refusals.message: Snow tiles need an exact shared 1/32 metre lattice within +/-512 metres, including the substrate.
Snow tiles need identity world transforms and static, unskinned geometry.
Snow tiles need the same visible cooked primitive for rendering and triangle collision.

too_many_samples.message: Snow inspection permits up to 64 sample pairs.

ordinary_step_with_stamp.message: Use runtime.snow.step with a snow_stamp to compact snow.

snow_step_without_stamp.message: Use runtime.snow.step with a snow_stamp to compact snow.

wrong_receiver.message: Snow stamp ray must first hit the expected upward-facing receiver triangle.

wrong_triangle.message: Snow stamp ray must first hit the expected upward-facing receiver triangle.

out_of_range_radius.message: Snow stamp radius must be within 128..1536 units.

malformed_depth.message: Revision must be a safe nonnegative JSON integer.

mark_after_staging.message: Surface mark ray must first hit the expected receiver with a surface normal.

held_stamp_refusal.message: Snow compaction would alter a held foot anchor. Release it before stamping.

diagnostic.message: Snow snapshot sample indices must be in range and strictly increasing.
Snow snapshot samples must have positive compaction within the frozen thickness.
Saved snow generation exceeds its committed tick.

qualification_corrections: Removed the starter floor collider after it occluded the compacted terrain in the first run.
The untouched triangle and intersection remained exact. Jolt compression changed the normalized contact by less than 2e-6.
Retained timed-mark discovery combined three entries and crossed its original 24 KiB cap. A dedicated snow step preserves the previous selection.

cpu_stamps.scope: Twenty fixed-tick stamps at each position, radius 512 and depth 3 lattice units. Independent fresh interior and seam sessions. Profiling covers simulation request scopes with no active render. These are microbenchmarks.
